Irida healed Mega Sharpedo and Lapras by 40 each; two Lucky Ice Pop uses healed the Mega's remaining 30 with heads then tails.
Arena raised Head Smash from 130 to 150 into Water ex attackers; second Fossil precharge survived Rare Candy and bypassed the Energy-lock plan.
The two cheap Rampardos attackers and exact 150-HP Ninetales knockout drove the finish.

Against a direct Head Smash KO, one point each would likely bring the score to 2-2; precise simultaneous point timing is not verified. The precharged second Fossil and hidden responses remain threats.

lead_notes: Lead inspected ordinary early Misty and Barry resources, the middle Turbo Shark and Rare Candy development, and eight exact final-state frames through Defeat. Fourteen-turn coverage, Energy and HP changes, 360 damage and the 2-3 result reconcile. The second Fossil has Fighting before Binding Snow and retains it through Rare Candy; the final 150 hit with Arena exactly knocks out Ninetales ex for two points. Astra accepts single-point Vulpix as a conditional survival alternative; the original 30-HP Rampardos is already below its conditional 50 self-damage threshold. Hidden responses and unobserved precise simultaneous point timing prevent a forced-win claim.
